one_line: A makeshift 'mech' built from a locker that a player can climb into, drive around with waddling steps, and use a Tension Belt to violently tip over and crush people.
player_facing_mechanics: Pilot the Locker Mech as an enclosed rideable vehicle (IS_ENCLOSED, with lights) that waddles as it moves
Seal/unseal the cabin: requires the power cell to be at least 80% charged, drains 5% of a standard cell charge per seal, and shows a 'not enough battery!' alert when too low
Melee attack (force 12) and movement both drain the installed power cell
Exit the vehicle with a 40-tick exit delay
Use the built-in Tension Belt melee equipment to rock the mech back and forth and try to tip it over onto a targeted turf
Tipping only works when the mech has a power cell and both the mech and target turf have gravity; a warning message ('starts rocking back and forward... going to fall over!') plays first
A successful tip makes the mech fall over and crush any mob on the target turf (3s knockdown) other than the pilot
If it falls but crushes nobody, the mech and its pilot both take damage equal to 70% of the mech's force and the pilot screams
After falling, the pilot is paralyzed (~2.2s) and the mech is visually tilted then auto-rights itself ~2s later
Destroying the mech spawns a plain closet (locker) at its location

port_notes: An SS14 port needs a vehicle/mecha entity prototype plus a system for piloting, doors/cabin sealing, energy drain and melee, then a separate 'tip over' system or action: the Tension Belt becomes an Action/DoAfter that validates gravity and target turf, spawns a landing-zone marker, and on completion fires an event that crushes mobs (Knockdown) or damages the mech/pilot. Mecha mechanics map to components (MechaComponent, equipment slots), systems, events, DoAfter, Actions, and the movable/rideable components; the tilt visuals become sprite rotation/offset animation via engine client-side systems, and the waddling becomes a movable modifier or animation. Human questions: whether to model the parent set_cabin_seal override globally (it currently affects ALL mechas, likely a bug), how to represent equip categories and the single Left-Arm-only slot, and whether the locker-spawns-on-destruction and the planned nuke-op/emag variant should be built.
